description: This file manages batching and uploading of embedding requests to the Gemini API, including constructing requests, handling responses, polling for batch completion, and processing embedding outputs.

methods.name: getGeminiUploadUrl
methods.description: Constructs the upload URL for Gemini based on the base URL, adjusting for beta endpoints.

methods.name: buildGeminiUploadBody
methods.description: Creates a multipart body Blob for uploading JSONL data to Gemini with a specific boundary.

methods.name: submitGeminiBatch
methods.description: Uploads a batch of requests to Gemini, creates a batch job, and returns its status.

methods.name: fetchGeminiBatchStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current status of a Gemini batch job.

methods.name: fetchGeminiFileContent
methods.description: Downloads the content of a Gemini output file by its ID.

methods.name: parseGeminiBatchOutput
methods.description: Parses the output text from Gemini batch responses into structured lines.

methods.name: waitForGeminiBatch
methods.description: Polls Gemini for batch completion, waiting until the batch succeeds or times out.
